title: 3-30-300 Layout
description: Layout configuration for the three attention-time layers: 3-second KPI cards, 30-second driver visuals, 300-second diagnostics with evidence table and action panel.

kpi_cards.description: 3-second layer: headline KPI cards shown at top of overview page.

kpi_id.description: KPI catalog ID (must exist in core/kpi_catalog/).

information_block.description: Visual Registry information block ID. KPI card slots always bind to status_signal. See core/templates/page_templates/visual_registry.yaml.

visuals_30s.description: 30-second layer: driver visuals (trend, variance, ranking, mix).

information_block.description: Visual Registry information block ID governing visual substitution rules for this slot. See core/templates/page_templates/visual_registry.yaml.

diagnostics_300s.description: 300-second layer: detail tables and matrices for drill-down diagnostics.

columns.description: Column references (entity keys or KPI IDs).

information_block.description: Visual Registry information block ID for this 300s slot. See core/templates/page_templates/visual_registry.yaml.

evidence_table.description: Structured evidence table config for the Detail_Matrix slot. Generated from UseCase_Bracket component_300s.evidence_columns and the data contract.

grain.description: Row grain of the evidence table (e.g. 'invoice_line', 'line_day', 'org_period').

columns.description: Column IDs: entity keys first, then KPI IDs in order of priority.

measures.description: Measure names from the semantic model to bind to measure columns.

sort_by.description: Default sort column (first KPI column recommended).

data_bars.description: Apply data bars to delta/variance columns.

action_panel.description: Action Panel config for the ActionPanel slot on T4 (prescriptive) detail pages. Phase 1: built at scaffold time from action-code YAML. Phase 2: driven from a semantic model table.

enabled.description: Whether the Action Panel slot is generated.

action_code_ids.description: Action code IDs to include (must exist in core/action_codes/). Taken from orchestration.action_code_ids in UseCase_Bracket.

payload_mode.description: Content depth: 'full' includes steps; 'summary' shows name/owner/trigger/impact; 'minimal' shows name/owner only.

phase2_table.description: Phase 2: Semantic model table name to drive the panel (e.g. 'ActionRecommendation'). Not used in Phase 1.
